statement: For the actual closed-disk relative centralizer of a closed locally compact free proper one-dimensional interior operator group, every continuous based sphere family S^n, n at least one, admits a based filling in the same group. Every positive-degree homotopy group at the identity is zero. Maps and inverses remain jointly continuous on the original closed disk and commute with every original interior operator.
depends_on: C33 actual principal coordinate and all component operators; C75-C77 exact endpoint characters and effective base actions; C50.3 five-letter additive path identity; C63 relative interlaced convex selection; C64 compact local preimages; C78 common compact positive averages and local pair transports; C79 common-base two-endpoint splice and both finite-endpoint sequence alternatives; C62 actual equal-level interval and inverse bounds
manuscript_passages: Section 23, folios 140-141, scans 279-281; Part C(b), all positive-degree based homotopy groups of the actual closed-disk relative centralizer for one-dimensional free proper interior operator groups.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The parameter domain is [0,1] times S^n with the explicit closed relative subset consisting of both end slices and the basepoint ray. Compact path-connected sphere short-pair families replace time increments. Zero-endpoint strips use a displayed convex base formula whose values have pointwise actual original-family labels, without a continuous choice of parameter paths. Every compact-family, operator and inverse comparison is retained.
computational_checks: This is a qualitative based-family filling theorem. The short-pair contraction, actual vector images, relative selections, exact maps and inverses, operator transport equations, and compact forward/inverse frontier bounds are proved directly. No numerical approximation or new finite classification is used.
notes: The result proves pi_n at the identity for every n at least one. It does not assert global contractibility or describe pi_0. Its source is the actual original closed disk, so no homotopy lift through the different-domain prime-end injection of C73 is inferred. C12's broader arbitrary-surface and original-compactification extension question remains open. Accepted C76-C79 and all earlier registered fragments are unchanged.
